name: Stoneweg
verdict: Geneva investment platform founded by Jaume Sabater; since October 2025 80.26% owned by SWI Capital Holding, in which Max-Hervé George holds 95.242% of the votes. Nothing found.
note: Co-owner (with NSN) of the team and jersey sponsor. Rating note: SWI's prospectus (16 Feb 2026) lists its substantial shareholders: Max-Hervé George (80.25% directly, 95.242% of the votes in all), Philae Real Estate (4.76%, a Jaume Sabater company) and ICF SPC-BG (14.99%, voted by George; its sole investor is MSB Trust, which has no voting rights). No state or state fund among them.
